name: Paracetamol
usage: Take with a glass of water. Can be taken with or without food.
usage_hi: पानी के एक गिलास के साथ लें। भोजन के साथ या उसके बिना लिया जा सकता है।
benefits: Effective for mild to moderate pain
benefits_hi: बुखार को जल्दी कम करता है
ज्यादातर उम्र के लोगों के लिए सुरक्षित
हल्के से मध्यम दर्द के लिए प्रभावी
safety: Avoid if you have liver issues.
safety_hi: यदि आपको लिवर की समस्या है तो इससे बचें।
urgentWarning: Stop use and consult a doctor immediately if you experience breathing difficulty or facial swelling.
urgentWarning_hi: यदि आपको सांस लेने में कठिनाई या चेहरे पर सूजन महसूस हो तो तुरंत उपयोग बंद करें और डॉक्टर से परामर्श करें।
storage: Keep in a cool, dry place below 25°C.
storage_hi: 25 डिग्री सेल्सियस से नीचे ठंडी और सूखी जगह पर रखें।
maternalDetails: Generally considered safe during pregnancy and breastfeeding if used for short periods at recommended doses.
maternalDetails_hi: अनुशंसित खुराक पर कम अवधि के लिए उपयोग किए जाने पर आमतौर पर गर्भावस्था और स्तनपान के दौरान सुरक्षित माना जाता है।
chronotherapy: Best taken in morning for all-day relief, or before bed for morning stiffness.

name: Ibuprofen
usage: Always take with food or milk to protect the stomach.
usage_hi: पेट की सुरक्षा के लिए हमेशा भोजन या दूध के साथ लें।
benefits_hi: जोड़ों और मांसपेशियों के दर्द से राहत देता है
safety: Avoid if you have asthma or stomach ulcers.
safety_hi: यदि आपको अस्थमा या पेट में छाले (अल्सर) हैं तो इससे बचें।
urgentWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if you notice black/tarry stools or vomit blood.
urgentWarning_hi: यदि आप काले/तारकोल जैसे मल या खून की उल्टी महसूस करें तो तुरंत चिकित्सकीय सहायता लें।
storage: Keep away from direct heat and moisture.
storage_hi: प्रत्यक्ष गर्मी और नमी से दूर रखें।
maternalDetails: Avoid in the third trimester of pregnancy (risk of heart issues in the baby). Consult a doctor before use.
maternalDetails_hi: गर्भावस्था की तीसरी तिमाही में बचें (बच्चे में हृदय संबंधी समस्याओं का खतरा)। उपयोग से पहले डॉक्टर से परामर्श करें।
chronotherapy: Effective for acute pain anytime, but best with morning/night meals.

name: Aspirin
usage: Dissolve in water if using efferent tablets.
usage_hi: यदि आप घुलने वाली गोलियों का उपयोग कर रहे हैं तो पानी में घोलकर लें।
safety: Do not give to children (Reye's syndrome risk).
safety_hi: बच्चों को न दें (रेये सिंड्रोम का खतरा)।
urgentWarning: NEVER give to children/teenagers with flu symptoms due to Reye's Syndrome risk. Seek help for bloody stools.
urgentWarning_hi: रेये सिंड्रोम के जोखिम के कारण फ्लू के लक्षणों वाले बच्चों/किशोरों को कभी न दें। खूनी मल के लिए सहायता लें।
storage: Keep in a cool dry place.
maternalDetails: Not recommended during pregnancy, especially in the last 3 months. Can affect child development.
maternalDetails_hi: गर्भावस्था के दौरान, विशेष रूप से पिछले 3 महीनों में अनुशंसित नहीं है। बच्चे के विकास को प्रभावित कर सकता है।
chronotherapy: Low-dose heart prevention best taken at night.

name: Naproxen
usage: Swallow whole with water; do not crush or chew.
usage_hi: पानी के साथ पूरा निगल लें; कुचलें या चबाएं नहीं।
benefits_hi: लंबे समय तक चलने वाली राहत (12 घंटे तक)
safety: May increase heart risk with long-term use.
safety_hi: लंबे समय तक उपयोग से हृदय जोखिम बढ़ सकता है।
urgentWarning: Stop use and see a doctor if you feel chest pain, shortness of breath, or weakness on one side of the body.
urgentWarning_hi: यदि आप सीने में दर्द, सांस की तकलीफ, या शरीर के एक तरफ कमजोरी महसूस करते हैं तो उपयोग बंद करें और डॉक्टर से मिलें।
storage: Store in original container protected from light.
storage_hi: मूल कंटेनर में प्रकाश से सुरक्षित रखें।
maternalDetails: Not recommended in the last trimester of pregnancy. Consult a doctor for use during breastfeeding.
maternalDetails_hi: गर्भावस्था के अंतिम तिमाही में अनुशंसित नहीं है। स्तनपान के दौरान उपयोग के लिए डॉक्टर से परामर्श करें।
chronotherapy: Best taken at night for morning joint stiffness relief.

name: Diclofenac
usage: Take with a full glass of water. Do not lie down for 10 mins.
usage_hi: एक पूरे गिलास पानी के साथ लें। 10 मिनट तक न लेटें।
benefits_hi: जोड़ों के तीव्र दर्द से राहत देता है
safety: Avoid if history of kidney disease.
safety_hi: यदि गुर्दे की बीमारी का इतिहास है तो इससे बचें।
urgentWarning: Seek immediate help for swelling of feet, sudden weight gain, or change in urine amount.
urgentWarning_hi: पैरों में सूजन, अचानक वजन बढ़ना, या मूत्र की मात्रा में परिवर्तन के लिए तुरंत सहायता लें।
maternalDetails: Avoid use during the third trimester. Can cause serious heart issues in unborn babies.
maternalDetails_hi: तीसरी तिमाही के दौरान उपयोग से बचें। अजन्मे बच्चों में गंभीर हृदय समस्याएं पैदा कर सकता है।
chronotherapy: Early evening dose is best for next-day arthritis relief.

name: Mefenamic Acid
usage: Take only for short-term relief (max 7 days).
safety: May cause drowsiness and stomach upset.

name: Tramadol
usage: Take strictly as prescribed. May be habit-forming.
safety: High risk of dependence; consult doctor only.

name: Celecoxib
usage: Can be taken without regard to meals.
safety: Consult if history of heart problems.

name: Nimesulide
usage: Use for the shortest duration possible.
safety: Banned in some countries due to liver risk.

name: Aceclofenac
usage: Best used for inflammatory bone conditions.
safety: Do not use with other NSAIDs.

name: Etoricoxib
usage: Take at the same time each day.

name: Ketorolac
usage: Not for long-term use (limit to 5 days).
benefits: Comparable to morphine for pain relief
safety: High risk of kidney and stomach issues if overused.

name: Piroxicam
usage: Effects can take 7-12 days to develop fully.

name: Fenoprofen
usage: Take 30 mins before or 2 hours after meals.

name: Guaifenesin
usage: Drink a full glass of water with each dose.
usage_hi: प्रत्येक खुराक के साथ एक पूरा गिलास पानी पिएं।
benefits_hi: आसानी से सफाई के लिए बलगम को पतला करता है
सीने की जकड़न को साफ करता है
safety_hi: यदि खांसी 7 दिनों से अधिक समय तक बनी रहती है तो परामर्श लें।
urgentWarning: Seek medical help if you develop a severe skin rash or persistent vomiting.
urgentWarning_hi: गंभीर त्वचा लालिमा या लगातार उल्टी होने पर चिकित्सकीय सहायता लें।
storage: Store at room temperature away from light.
storage_hi: कमरे के तापमान पर प्रकाश से दूर रखें।

name: Dextromethorphan
usage: Avoid caffeine while taking this medicine.
safety: May cause minor dizziness or sedation.

name: Phenylephrine
usage: Do not use for more than 7 days consecutively.
safety: Can raise blood pressure; avoid if hypertensive.

name: Oxymetazoline Spray
usage: Gently blow nose before using. Do not use for > 3 days.
safety: Overuse leads to 'Rebound Congestion'. Use sparingly.

name: Diphenhydramine
usage: Take at bedtime if using for nocturnal allergies.

name: Bromhexine
usage: Take after food with lots of water.
safety: Consult if history of stomach ulcers.

name: Ambroxol
usage: Liquid form is often more effective for throat soothing.

name: Cod Liver Oil
usage: Best swallowed whole; do not bite open.

name: Saline Spray
usage: Tilt head back slightly when spraying.
safety: Ensure tip is cleaned after use.

name: Levosalbutamol Inhaler
usage: Shake well before use. Rinse mouth after.
safety: Emergency use only; consult doctor for therapy.

name: Menthol Inhalation
usage: Inhale steam with head covered by towel. NO drinking.
safety: Risk of burns with hot water; keep away from kids.

name: Azee (Azithromycin)
usage: Take for exactly 3 or 5 days as prescribed. Do NOT skip.
safety: Consult for full course; misuse creates resistance.

name: Strepsils (Hexylresorcinol)
usage: Dissolve slowly in the mouth; do not chew.

name: Xylometazoline Drops
usage: Lie down on bed with head tilted back when applying.

name: Tulsi/Hony Syrups
usage: No drinking water for 15 mins after syrup.
safety: Safe for kids; but check sugar if diabetic.

name: Omeprazole
usage: Take in the morning, 30-60 minutes before breakfast.
usage_hi: सुबह, नाश्ते से 30-60 मिनट पहले लें।
benefits_hi: पेट की परत को ठीक करता है
safety: Report bone pain with long-term use.
safety_hi: लंबे समय तक उपयोग के साथ हड्डियों में दर्द की रिपोर्ट करें।
urgentWarning: Consult a doctor if you develop severe watery diarrhea or joint pain.
urgentWarning_hi: यदि आपको गंभीर पानी जैसा दस्त या जोड़ों में दर्द महसूस हो तो डॉक्टर से परामर्श करें।
storage: Store in a cool place, tightly closed container.
storage_hi: ठंडी जगह पर, कसकर बंद डिब्बे में रखें।
maternalDetails: Generally weight-for-weight safe. Widely used for pregnancy-related GERD.
maternalDetails_hi: आमतौर पर वजन-दर-वजन सुरक्षित। गर्भावस्था से संबंधित जीईआरडी के लिए व्यापक रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है।
chronotherapy: MUST be taken 30-60 mins BEFORE breakfast for max acid suppression.

name: Pantoprazole
usage: Take with water. Do not crush the tablet.
usage_hi: पानी के साथ लें। टैबलेट को कुचलें नहीं।
safety: Monitor B12 levels if used for months.
safety_hi: यदि महीनों तक उपयोग किया जाता है तो बी12 स्तरों की निगरानी करें।
urgentWarning: Seek help if you experience chest pain spreading to the jaw (may mimic heart attack).
urgentWarning_hi: यदि आप जबड़े तक फैलने वाले सीने में दर्द का अनुभव करते हैं तो सहायता लें (यह दिल के दौरे जैसा हो सकता है)।
storage: Store below 30°C in a dry place.
storage_hi: सूखी जगह पर 30 डिग्री सेल्सियस से नीचे स्टोर करें।

name: Loperamide
usage: Drink plenty of water to prevent dehydration.
usage_hi: निर्जलीकरण को रोकने के लिए खूब पानी पिएं।
benefits_hi: अतिसक्रिय आंत को शांत करता है
safety: Avoid if stools contain blood or you have fever.
safety_hi: यदि मल में रक्त हो या आपको बुखार हो तो इससे बचें।
urgentWarning: Stop use and consult doctor if diarrhea lasts for more than 48 hours or you feel faint.
urgentWarning_hi: यदि दस्त 48 घंटे से अधिक समय तक रहता है या आप बेहोशी महसूस करते हैं तो उपयोग बंद करें और डॉक्टर से परामर्श करें।
storage: Keep in a cool place, away from children.
storage_hi: बच्चों से दूर, ठंडी जगह पर रखें।

name: Digene (Antacid)
usage: Chew tablets well for faster relief.
usage_hi: बेहतर राहत के लिए गोलियों को अच्छी तरह चबाएं।
benefits_hi: पेट के एसिड को बेअसर करता है
safety: Contains Magnesium; may cause mild diarrhea.
safety_hi: मैग्नीशियम शामिल है; हल्का दस्त हो सकता है।
sideEffects_hi: कड़वा स्वाद होने पर परामर्श लें
urgentWarning: Check batch number; discontinue if unusual bitter taste or odor is noticed.
urgentWarning_hi: बैच नंबर की जांच करें; यदि असामान्य कड़वा स्वाद या गंध दिखाई दे तो उपयोग बंद कर दें।
storage: Shake well before use (Liquid). Store in a cool place.
storage_hi: उपयोग से पहले अच्छी तरह हिलाएं (तरल)। ठंडी जगह पर स्टोर करें।

name: Metronidazole
usage: Take with or after food. Avoid ALCOHOL completely.

name: Domperidone
safety: Consult if history of heart rhythm issues.

name: Psyllium Husk (Isabgol)
usage: Mix with water/milk and drink IMMEDIATELY.
safety: Must drink 2-3L of water daily while using fiber.

name: ORS (Electral)
usage: Use boiled and cooled water. Solution expires in 24h.

name: Charcoal Tabs
usage: Take 1-2 hours away from other medicines.

name: Dicyclomine
usage: Take with water. Best for intestinal spasm pain.
safety: May cause dry mouth or blurred vision.

name: Meftal Spas
usage: Specifically formulated for abdominal muscle pain.
safety: Avoid if pregnant or have asthma.

name: Simethicone (Gas-X)
usage: Take with or without food. Chew tablets.

name: Bismuth Subsalicylate
usage: Chew well or shake liquid form.
benefits: Pink liquid magic for upset stomach
safety: Do not use if allergic to Aspirin.

name: Cetirizine
usage: Typically taken once in the evening.
usage_hi: आमतौर पर शाम को एक बार लिया जाता है।
benefits_hi: कई लोगों के लिए नींद न आने देने वाला
पुरानी पित्ती का इलाज करता है
safety: Avoid alcohol as it may increase sedation.
safety_hi: शराब से बचें क्योंकि यह सुस्ती बढ़ा सकती है।
urgentWarning: Seek help if you experience irregular heartbeat or severe restless feeling.
urgentWarning_hi: अनियमित दिल की धड़कन या गंभीर बेचैनी महसूस होने पर सहायता लें।
storage: Keep in a cool, dry place.
storage_hi: ठंडी और सूखी जगह पर रखें।

name: Loratadine (Claritin)
usage: Take with water. Best non-sedating option.
safety: Consult if history of liver disease.

name: Fexofenadine (Allegra)
usage: Do not take with fruit juice (Apple/Orange/Grape).

name: Calamine Lotion
usage: Shake well. Apply using cotton wool to the affected area.
safety: For external use only. Keep away from eyes.

name: Hydrocortisone Cream
usage: Wash hands before and after applying. Use tiny amount.
safety: Do not use on infected or broken skin.

name: Clotrimazole Cream
usage: Clean/dry the area. Continue for 2 weeks after relief.
safety: Avoid contact with condoms (may weaken them).

name: Betadine (Povidone-Iodine)
usage: Clean wound first. Apply and cover with bandage if needed.
safety: May stain skin/clothing. Avoid if thyroid issues.

name: Aloe Vera Gel
usage: Best if kept in the fridge for extra cooling.
safety: Test patch first for sensitive skin.

name: Fusidic Acid Cream
usage: Treat for 7-10 days. Do not use for > 14 days.

name: Salicylic Acid Patch
usage: Soak foot in warm water for 5 mins before applying.
safety: Don't use on diabetic feet or poor circulation.

name: Benzoyl Peroxide
usage: Apply only to spots. May bleach hair or fabric.
safety: Starts with dry skin; use moisturizer.

name: Mupirocin (T-Bact)
usage: Keep the area covered after application.

name: Mometasone Cream
usage: Powerful steroid; use only on affected spots.
safety: Do not use for more than 2 weeks on face.

name: Vaseline Jelly
usage: Locks in moisture. Best applied on damp skin.

name: Ketoconazole Shampoo
usage: Leave on scalp for 5 mins before rinsing.

name: Vitamin C (Limcee)
usage: Chew the tablet well. Can be taken any time.
usage_hi: गोली को अच्छी तरह चबाएं। इसे किसी भी समय लिया जा सकता है।
safety: Excess can cause kidney stones in some.
safety_hi: अधिकता से कुछ लोगों में गुर्दे की पथरी हो सकती है।
urgentWarning: Consult doctor if you have a history of kidney stones before taking high doses.
urgentWarning_hi: उच्च खुराक लेने से पहले यदि आपको गुर्दे की पथरी का इतिहास है तो डॉक्टर से परामर्श करें।
storage: Keep container tightly closed in a cool place.
storage_hi: सीधे ठंडे स्थान पर कंटेनर को कसकर बंद रखें।

name: Vitamin D3 (Calcirol)
usage: MUST take with a meal that contains fat (Milk/Nuts).
safety: Check Vitamin D levels before high dosing.

name: Iron + Folic Acid
usage: Take with Vitamin C (Orange juice) for 2x absorption.
safety: Avoid dairy/tea within 2h of taking. Stools turn black.

name: B-Complex (Becosules)
usage: Take with food to avoid stomach irritation.

name: Calcium + Vit D
usage: Calcium Citrate is better absorbed on empty stomach.
safety: Consult if history of kidney stones.

name: Magnesium Glycinate
usage: Take 1-2 hours before bedtime for sleep.
safety: May cause loose stools if overused.

name: Fish Oil (Omega 3)
usage: Store in a cool place to avoid fishy smell.
safety: May act as a mild blood thinner.

name: Zinc Acetate
usage: Take at the very first sign of a cold.
safety: May cause nausea if taken without food.

name: Biotin (Vit B7)
usage: Consistency is key; usually takes 3 months to see results.
safety: May interfere with thyroid blood tests.

name: Multivitamins (A-Z)
usage: A supplement, not a food replacement. Take with water.
safety: Ensure no overlapping with other supplements.

name: Probiotic (Bifilac)
usage: Take with cold water; heat kills the bacteria.
safety: Keep refrigerated if mentioned on label.

name: Vitamin E (Evion)
usage: Can also be applied topically for skin/hair care.
safety: High doses can increase bleeding risk.

name: CoQ10 (Ubiquinone)
usage: Take with fat-containing meals for 3x absorption.
safety: Consult if taking blood pressure meds.

name: Glucosamine
usage: Needs 4-8 weeks to start showing results.
safety: Avoid if shellfish allergy (derived from shells).

name: Ashwagandha (Herb)
usage: Taken traditionally with warm milk at night.
safety: Avoid if history of autoimmune diseases.

name: Amlodipine
usage: Take at the same time every day. Do not skip.
maternalDetails: Used for pregnancy-induced hypertension under specialist supervision.
maternalDetails_hi: विशेषज्ञ की देखरेख में गर्भावस्था-प्रेरित उच्च रक्तचाप के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।
chronotherapy: Consistent morning intake maintains steady 24h blood pressure control.

name: Atorvastatin (Lipitor)
usage: Usually taken in the evening for best result.
safety: Avoid grapefruit juice. Inform if muscle pain.

name: Clopidogrel
usage: Important after stent placement. Do not stop abruptly.
safety: High risk of bleeding; inform before any surgery.

name: Ramipril
usage: Take with water. May cause dizziness initially.

name: Furosemide (Lasix)
usage: Take in the morning. DO NOT take at night (frequent urination).
safety: Monitor Potassium levels; risk of dehydration.

name: Spironolactone
usage: Often combined with other BP meds.

name: Diltiazem
usage: Swallow whole; do not chew extended release tabs.
safety: Caution if you have a slow heart rate.

name: Warfarin
usage: Vitamin K intake (Green Veg) must be consistent.

name: Digitoxin
usage: Narrow safety window. Take exactly as prescribed.
safety: Toxicity signs include yellow halo in vision.

name: Ciprofloxacin
usage: Avoid milk/calcium within 2h of dose. Drink lots of water.
safety: Risk of tendon pain (rare). Finish the full course.

name: Cystone (Arjuna)
usage: Drink 4 liters of water for best effect on stones.

name: Nitrofurantoin
usage: Take with food or milk to stay safe from stomach upset.

name: Potassium Citrate
usage: MUST dilute in a full glass of water. Sip slowly.
safety: Monitor Potassium if taking heart meds.

name: Tamsulosin
usage: Take 30 mins after the SAME meal each day.
safety: May cause sudden dizziness (stand up slowly).

name: Uralyt-U
usage: Titrate dose based on urine pH strips.
safety: Check heart status before starting sodium/potassium salts.

name: Metformin
usage: Take with a meal to reduce stomach side effects.
